### 📖 Tutorials
> Any articles about Gaia. Please add the title, link, and brief instructions for your article.

- **[Integrate Gaia with Cursor](https://medium.com/@zulfanbaswedan/harnessing-the-power-of-gaia-and-cursor-ai-ide-for-enhanced-development-productivity-c0e4df474568)**: A step-by-step guide to install Gaia and use a Gaia node as the LLM backend service for Cursor.
- **[Agentic translation on Gaia](https://docs.gaianet.ai/tutorial/translator-agent)**: A step-by-step guide to install Gaia and use a Gaia node as the LLM backend service for Agentic translation.
- **[Calling external tools](https://docs.gaianet.ai/tutorial/tool-call)**: Run a Gaia node that supports tool call.
- **[Working with Coinbase AgentKit](https://docs.gaianet.ai/tutorial/coinbase)**: Use your own Gaia node to power the [Coinbase AgentKit](https://github.com/coinbase/cdp-agentkit).
- **[Working with Eliza](https://docs.gaianet.ai/tutorial/eliza)**: Now use Gaia as the LLM service backend for the Eliza framework, a simple, fast, and lightweight AI agent framework.
- **[Social AI Agent using Eliza x Gaia](https://github.com/elizaOS/eliza/blob/3b334cbdff0b4c0e82c072fbd38a9b9c16918d2e/docs/community/ai-dev-school/nader_tutorial_15min.md?plain=1#L46)**: Learn how to quickly build your own social media AI agent using Eliza and Gaia.

### 🎬 Videos

> Any videos about Gaia. Please add the title, link, and brief instructions for your video.

- **[Join the Revolution: How to Set Up Your Node for Gaia is Groundbreaking Beta Launch!](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7MtKELK5IoM)**: Learn what is Gaia and how to run your own node.

- **[A step by step guide to configure Dify!](https://twitter.com/Gaianet_AI/status/1823434426837057547)**: Develop LLM agnets based on Dify and Gaia.

- **[A step by step guide to use GroqBook!](https://twitter.com/Gaianet_AI/status/1814402294764487058)**: Ask a Gaia node to write a book based on your prompt.

- **[Generate code using CodeGPT and Gaia](https://twitter.com/Gaianet_AI/status/1829504390287311113)**: Use CodeGPT and Gaia to generate code.

- **[A virtual Pasor powered by Gaia](https://youtu.be/lQem46YSpSc)**: Talk to a virtual pasor and get some suggestions.

- **[Generate a web UI from a natural language description using Gaia and LlamaCoder](https://youtu.be/L2Rt94nCd2A)**: Generate React apps in human languages.

- **[Why Gaia Choose Wasm](https://youtu.be/Bt5i9bOeJ50)**: Wasm is portable accross CPUs and GPUs, so the gaia node can run everywhere.

- **[Prompt Engineering Tool](https://youtu.be/0ZubRw0oA64)**: Test your AI Agents with multiple LLMs using Gaia's Prompt Engineering Tool. [➡️ Try it!](https://prompt-engineering-toolkit-rho.vercel.app/)

- **[Spinning Up Your Own Node with Gaia](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LVYXtg39t6c)**: This video is your ultimate guide to setting up your very own Gaia node! 

- **[How we built a 🏎️ Formula 1 AI Agent using Gaia](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jgD3TRDSQ8A)**: In this video, we take you behind the scenes of how we built a cutting-edge Formula 1 AI Agent using Gaia! [➡️ Try it!](https://formula1.gaianet.network/chatbot-ui/index.html)

- **[Build a Social AI Agent in 15 Minutes](https://youtu.be/6PZVwNTl5hI?si=0zB3OvYU4KiRQTxI)**: Learn how to create your own AI social media agent using the Eliza framework by a16z using TypeScript and Gaia's LLM.
  
- **[Generate Insights for web3 Data using AI powered by Gaia Node](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ht0NG-LoxYs)**: Learn how to integrate Web3 and AI by leveraging public Gaia nodes.Let's see how to combine data from Web3 with AI to generate insights using The Graph. 
  
- **[Plain Text to Embeddings](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qo43dv_Oero)**: Learn how to convert a plain text file knowledge base into a snapshot for your Gaia node. 

- **[RAG Tool for converting a Plain Text file into an embedding](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HO-WHBPKDC4)**

- **[Converting Markdown files to Embeddings](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vjIVfrAjqEw)**: Learn in 10 minutes, how to convert markdown files into embeddings using Docker + Qdrant Vector Database + Gaia.

- **[CodeGPT + Gaia: Your AI-Powered Pair Programming Partner!](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JdIB7g01zBM)**: You can easily configure CodeGPT to use Gaia Nodes as your LLM backend.

- **[How to Supercharge Cursor IDE with Your Gaia Node: A Complete Guide!](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ve_bEZL_rYQ)**: Integrating Gaia AI with Cursor IDE offers a powerful, secure, and customized coding experience.

- **[Create a Telegram Bot using Gaia Node & Eliza](https://x.com/HarishKotra/status/1882760259065745529)**: Learn how to create a Telegram bot, integrating it with Eliza, and customizing it with your specialized knowledge. Follow along to make your AI agent behave just the way you want.

- **[Create a Discord Bot using Gaia Node & Eliza](https://x.com/HarishKotra/status/1883160396573348177)**: Set up Gaia node as your LLM for an autonomous AI agent in Discord with Eliza framework. Learn how to create a developer token, adding a bot to your server using the Eliza framework.

- **[Run DeepSeek-R1 Locally](https://x.com/HarishKotra/status/1882403316640161855)**: Truly run DeepSeek-R1 locally on your machine using a Gaia node and here's a video on how to do it in under 10 minutes!
- **[x402 Payments for Gaia Nodes](https://youtu.be/W2B_8f4zMwM)**: This project demonstrates how to create a paid API service that proxies requests to a Gaia Node's API endpoint, using the x402 protocol for per-request payments on EVM-compatible chains like Base Sepolia.
- **[Run thinking models on Gaia Nodes](https://youtu.be/e7N8583IzQM)**: Gaia nodes now  have the ability to run thinking models which give node operators and builders the flexibility to choose the model's thinking behavior based on the use-case you're building with Gaia nodes.
- **[What are Gaia Domains](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TwKdcDnmwpw)**: Learn what Gaia Domains are and how they allow you to scale decentralized AI inference.
- **[Run DeepSeek-R1-0528-Qwen3-8B Locally with Gaia](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bgiwr1_xNSk)**: DeepSeek-R1-0528-Qwen3-8B is an exciting model that was created by distilling the chain-of-thought from DeepSeek-R1-0528 to post-train Qwen3 8B Base. Learn how to leverage this incredible AI right from your desktop.
